title: Manage Seerr requests in Jellydash
summary: Browse the full request queue and open the exact request from a notification.
highlights: Use the All requests, Pending approval and Failed tabs. Open a poster to see who requested it, the edition and the selected seasons.
Managers can approve, decline, retry or delete a request, and edit supported choices while it's pending. Deleting a request keeps its library files.
With login on, owners and admins can manage requests by default. With login off, the queue starts view-only. Library file removal is a separate opt-in and is off by default.
History handles short replays, Saved posters keeps your search during a refresh, and Downloads keeps the last usable results when a reply is invalid.
